name: nexora-elite-signals
description: NEXORA Elite Signals Telegram quant signal infrastructure

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:engines && npm run build:services && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nexora/types && npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run build -w @nexora/utils
scripts.build:engines: npm run build -w @nexora/football-over15-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/football-btts-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/football-doublechance-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/nba-playerprops-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/nba-teamtotals-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/nba-firsthalf-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/tennis-hardcourt-overgames-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/mlb-first5-engine
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w @nexora/data-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/tennis-data-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/mlb-data-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/market-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/signal-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/telegram-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/clv-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/risk-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/analytics-engine && npm run build -w @nexora/persistence-engine
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @nexora/api && npm run build -w @nexora/worker
